These third-party components remain subject to their respective license terms. Vidro itself is licensed under the [MIT License](../LICENCE.md). This is not a complete audit of the distributed dependency tree or incorporated assets.

The Brazilian Portuguese Monaco catalog incorporates translations from Microsoft vscode-loc, pinned at `0f157dee0cdcbf58cdf51a221ee94751c7f35e75`, under its [MIT license](vscode-loc/LICENSE). The source-key mapping follows Monaco 0.57.0 / VS Code `6a598d4a13031703d483d103c1d934a36ad27971`. Vidro authors the small Portuguese supplement and Vietnamese catalog.
